interventions.detail: Python 3.6 obtained from conda-forge via micromamba (system 3.12 and uv cannot provide <=3.7); uv venv built on it
pinned numpy 1.14.5, scipy 1.1.0, pandas 0.25.3, pytz, protobuf 3.19.6 for TF 1.10 compatibility; skipped mpi4py
downloaded/extracted CIFAR-10 binary and created path.conf from template with data_dir_local_cifar10
no nvidia-smi: get_idle_gpus.py traceback is non-fatal; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' set in env.sh for CPU
